548938.title: First Steps on the Battlefield
548938.description: Clear your first area. Every other achievement requires Normal difficulty or above

548939.title: The Sorcerer's Pet
548939.description: [Valkyrie] Chase the Queen of the Fairies, face Belial, and live to tell the tale to clear Chapter 1

548940.title: The Crimson Witch
548940.description: [Valkyrie] Explore the Deep Forests of Elrit and confront the forest witch Velvet to clear Chapter 2

548941.title: Traitor Handling
548941.description: [Valkyrie] Traverse the Winterhorn Ridge, defy General Brigan, and free your half sister to clear Chapter 3

548942.title: Royal Exorcism
548942.description: [Valkyrie] Plow through your father's troops and liberate him from the spirit haunting him to clear Chapter 4

548943.title: Hands Off, Onyx
548943.description: [Valkyrie] Blaze through fiery pits and support your husband against Leventhan to clear Chapter 5

548944.title: One Woman Army
548944.description: [Valkyrie] Invade Ringford on your own and get back Titrel to clear Chapter 6

548945.title: Death Denied
548945.description: [Valkyrie] Force yourself through the Netherworld to claim Oswald back from the Queen of the Dead to clear the Epilogue

548946.title: Maybe Find a Moon Pearl
548946.description: [The Pooka Prince] Prove yourself worthy of a second chance at life to clear Chapter 1

548947.title: Learning About the Pooka Curse
548947.description: [The Pooka Prince] Gain the respect of King Odin by giving a lesson to Lord Brigan to clear Chapter 2

548948.title: Just Who Are You?
548948.description: [The Pooka Prince] Hunt down the impostor through the forest and defeat them to clear Chapter 3

548949.title: A Song of Fire and Ice
548949.description: [The Pooka Prince] Search for Hindel on the snowy peaks of Winterhorn, find a different, raging, dragon, and defeat them to clear Chapter 4

548950.title: Cyrano and Roxane
548950.description: [The Pooka Prince] Interfere in the war raging above ground to save your beloved to clear Chapter 5

548951.title: The Birth of Leventhan
548951.description: [The Pooka Prince] Reclaim coins from the goblins and foil King Valentine's plot to clear Chapter 6

548952.title: Rightful Heir
548952.description: [The Pooka Prince] Purge the lawless streets of Titania and free Belial from enslavement to clear the Epilogue

548953.title: Heavy Crown for a Maiden
548953.description: [Fairy Land] Hunt some frogs and survive a draconic ambush to clear Chapter 1

548954.title: Gimme a Kiss
548954.description: [Fairy Land] Suppress the rebellion brewing in Ringford and defeat Melvin's goon to clear Chapter 2

548955.title: Earning Some Respect
548955.description: [Fairy Land] Show the might of a maiden to Wagner to clear Chapter 3

548956.title: Sewer Scum
548956.description: [Fairy Land] Track down the three wise men, corner Beldor, and have frog deliver them an eternal punishment to clear Chapter 4

548957.title: Death is Just a Suggestion in Erion
548957.description: [Fairy Land] Pull the legendary blacksmith Brom back from the dead to clear Chapter 5

548958.title: Emerald Blaze
548958.description: [Fairy Land] Sneak into Volkenon Lava Pit to rob green flames and show King Valentine that his new pet is still a weakling to clear Chapter 6

548959.title: Legitimacy Proved and Secured
548959.description: [Fairy Land] Rally the troups, engage the forces of Ragnanival, and destroy Odin's Sphere to clear the Epilogue

548960.title: What Is This Feeling?
548960.description: [The Black Sword] Infiltrate Nebulapolis, beat up a drunk fool, and set your eyes on Odin's witch for the first time to clear Chapter 1

548961.title: Cursed Warrrior
548961.description: [The Black Sword] Engage the valkyries and survive an ambush by the Halja to clear Chapter 2

548962.title: Forceful Recruitment
548962.description: [The Black Sword] Convince Beldor to join Melvin's rebellion to clear Chapter 3

548963.title: A New Pledge
548963.description: [The Black Sword] Explore the Netherworld to find a new master, perform your first task for her then dip out to clear Chapter 4

548964.title: Puny Lizards
548964.description: [The Black Sword] Go on a hunt and take down yet another dragon to clear Chapter 5

548965.title: Your Princess Is in Another Castle!
548965.description: [The Black Sword] Chase Skuldi through the streets of Titania and learn about Gwendolyn's whereabouts using any means necessary to clear Chapter 6

548966.title: Through the Fire and Flames
548966.description: [The Black Sword] Face the Inferno King himself and rescue Gwendolyn from the fiery pits of Volkenon to clear the Epilogue

548967.title: A First Clue to Avoid a Gruesome Fate
548967.description: [Fate] Delve into Netherworld Endelphia, get your hands on mysterious psalms, and defend yourself against Queen Odette to clear Chapter 1

548968.title: Grand Larceny
548968.description: [Fate] Sneak into Ringford, snatch Titrel, and leave without a scratch to clear Chapter 2

548969.title: Putting the Catastrophe on Hold
548969.description: [Fate] Rush to the Cauldron, take care of some vermin in the way, and hopefully disable it to clear Chapter 3

548970.title: Well Above the Clouds
548970.description: [Fate] Find an unexpected ally and hiding place for Titrel to clear Chapter 4

548971.title: Standing Up to Your So-Called Father
548971.description: [Fate] Get King Odin's on his knees and learn more about your mother to clear Chapter 5

548972.title: The Wise Men Plot
548972.description: [Fate] Request an audience with Cornelius to King Edmund and get trapped by wise men to clear Chapter 6

548973.title: Three Headed Twin
548973.description: [Fate] Learn the truth about who unleashed the cauldron and face the Beast of Darkova to clear the Epilogue

548974.title: Smite Me, Please
548974.description: [Armageddon] As Mercedes, break the spell of Darkova afflicting Ingway to clear Chapter 1

548975.title: Born Together, Died Together
548975.description: [Armageddon] As Velvet, show mercy and put your brother to rest to clear Chapter 1

548976.title: Go Back to Your Grave
548976.description: [Armageddon] As Gwendolyn or Oswald, stop the rampaging Beast of Darkova to clear Chapter 1

548977.title: The Pooka Fulfilling the Prophecy
548977.description: [Armageddon] As Cornelius, free Ingway from Beldor's control to clear Chapter 1 and fulfill the first prophecy

548978.title: Becoming Part of the Nightmare
548978.description: [Armageddon] As Cornelius, intercept your rotting grandfather before he reaches Titania and delay the inevitable for as long as you can to clear Chapter 2

548979.title: A Blessing in Disguise
548979.description: [Armageddon] As Gwendolyn, Mercedes or Velvet, face the forever regenerating King of the Netherworld until you can't take it to clear Chapter 2

548980.title: The Dark Knight Fulfilling the Prophecy
548980.description: [Armageddon] As Oswald, exterminate King Gallon and learn about your heritage to clear Chapter 2 and fulfill the second prophecy

548981.title: Falling to the Obsessive Leader
548981.description: [Armageddon] As Gwendolyn, defend yourself against the jealous monarch to clear Chapter 3

548982.title: Lost Soul
548982.description: [Armageddon] As Oswald, resist against the blazing inferno to clear Chapter 3

548983.title: The Cauldron Better Be Ready to Boil
548983.description: [Armageddon] As Cornelius or Velvet, attempt to halt King Onyx's march to clear Chapter 3

548984.title: The Prophecized Birth of the World Tree
548984.description: [Armageddon] As Mercedes, give your life to quench the flames scorching the earth to clear Chapter 3 and fulfill the third prophecy

548985.title: And Boom Goes the Cauldron
548985.description: [Armageddon] As anyone but Velvet, stop the Cauldron and witness its instability to clear Chapter 4

548986.title: The Red Witch's Prophecized Brew
548986.description: [Armageddon] As Velvet, stop the Cauldron survive the encounter to clear Chapter 4 and fulfill the fourth prophecy

548987.title: An Omen from the Sky
548987.description: [Armageddon] As anyone but Gwendolyn, throw everything you have at the Last Dragon until the world collapses to clear Chapter 5

548988.title: The Sole Surviving Daughter of the Old World
548988.description: [Armageddon] As Gwendolyn, defeat Leventhan, the Last Dragon, and fall to your fate to clear Chapter 5 and fulfill the fifth prophecy

548989.title: As Foretold by the Prophecies
548989.description: [Armageddon] Fulfill every prophecy and let the revival of the land begin!
